pr_title: Fixes Plot(string, PyObject) handling of indicators.
pr_body:
#### Description
`Plot(string, PyObject)` was not properly handling all types of indicators. With this fix, we capture the `.Current.Value` directly from the python object instead of converting it into an `IIndicator` object.

#### Related Issue
Closes #2771 

#### Motivation and Context
Bugfix.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Manually using the snipped from the related issue.

issue_context.title: Exception thrown when plotting ADX indicator
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
`Plot(string, indicator)` method works in python for all indicator types.

#### Actual Behavior
`ArgumentException : QCAlgorithm.Plot(): The last argument should be a QuantConnect Indicator object, <class 'QuantConnect.Indicators.AverageDirectionalIndex'> was provided.`

#### Potential Solution
Fix `Plot(string, PyObject)` method by using `Current.Value` from the `PyObject` directly.

#### Reproducing the Problem
```python
self.adx = self.ADX("IWM", 14, Resolution.Daily)
self.Plot('ADX', self.adx)
```

- [x] I have completely filled out this template
